title: All Win prop firm preset release v1
description: One machine-readable release of one firm's presets (V1-S16; research format docs/product/presets/preset-research-format.md §5). The publisher writes it from a PO-reviewed research file; the Core validates it against this schema and its own consistency rules before it imports it as the firm's next release. Files carry stable keys, never database ids. Money is a string, never a number. Owner: Software Architect (Compasso); Esquadro approves.

schema_version.description: Major 1; a newer minor may add optional fields only. 1.1 adds drawdown trailing_lock (Q90) and title_note, with page_title optional on a quote; the Core accepts 1.0 and 1.1, and refuses a 1.0 file that uses a 1.1 field (README check 12).

domains.description: Official domains; every quote and source URL must be on one of them (checked by the Core).

manual_only.description: S16 AC-7: no V1 output reaches the firm's platforms; risk tracking only.

version_number.description: Exactly the previous release + 1 (1 for a new firm). The Core refuses a gap or a repeat.

research_file.description: The evidence file this release was built from.

changes.description: Empty for version 1. The Core checks it against the previous release; a mismatch rejects the import.

manual_only.description: S-R3-2 / S-R3-4: this firm platform cannot be reached by any V1 output, so accounts on it are manual only (HTTP `FirmDetail.platforms[].manual_only`). `reason` is the firm's quote, or the publisher's research text when the firm states nothing.

automation.description: One text without `firm_platform`, or one per firm platform.

excluded_plans.description: Plans not offered as presets (S16 AC-9).

money.description: Non-negative money as a decimal string, exactly as published (no rounding, X-3).

platform.description: Firm-side platform code (HTTP `FirmPlatform`), e.g. `rithmic`, `tradovate`. Not the execution platform.

localized.description: Publisher text in both UI languages (never firm text).

quote.description: A verbatim quote of the firm's official text in the firm's language (never translated). Plain text; clients render it as text, never HTML or Markdown. page_title is optional from 1.1: a page that blocks automated access (e.g. Apex, TPT) has no title, but carries title_note, url and accessed_at.

title_note.description: 1.1 (user decision 2026-10-24; Torno): only when page_title is absent, because the site blocks automated access (e.g. Apex, TPT). A short plain-text note from the publisher, in English, e.g. 'title not retrieved: site blocks automated access, 2026-10-24'. The url is the link. The title is never derived. Required on a quote without page_title.

research.description: Where the publisher looked and found no rule (with `unknown`).

quote.description: Short verbatim sentence for a dynamic page (research format §2).

title_note.description: 1.1 (user decision 2026-10-24; Torno): only when page_title is absent, because the site blocks automated access (e.g. Apex, TPT). A short plain-text note from the publisher, in English, e.g. 'title not retrieved: site blocks automated access, 2026-10-24'. The url is the link. The title is never derived. Optional on a source without page_title.

provenance_status.description: `not_confirmed`: the firm's official pages disagree; ≥ 2 `published_values`, no `value`, never prefilled (S16 AC-5/AC-6).

rule_text.description: One opt-in rule text (automation or copy) for the firm, or for one firm platform when the stance differs by platform. `version` is the publisher's number for this (kind, platform) text: it increases on every stance or text change and stays the same otherwise. The Core assigns the rule version id (HTTP `RuleVersion.id`) and rejects a release whose `version` goes back or changes the text or stance without increasing.

change.description: The transition INTO this `version` (Q26, Q42), required when `version` > 1. The Core reads it only when it imports this version for the first time (the stored version + 1). When `version` equals the stored one, the text is unchanged and `change` is ignored, so a stale cause never suspends accounts again.

cause.description: `stance_changed` and `text_changed` move `chosen` accounts to `pending_review`; `not_material` (typo or format fix) never suspends.

stance_info.description: VPS/server and personal-device stances (S16 AC-8): verbatim quotes, never translated. `unknown` → `research` and no quotes; `not_confirmed` → at least 2 conflicting quotes (S16 AC-5); any other value → at least 1 quote and no `research`.

trailing_lock.description: 1.1 (Q90 a; HTTP 5.4.0 DrawdownValue.trailing_lock). Where a trailing drawdown stops trailing: floor_reaches_start locks the floor at size_amount + offset; never = it never stops. The publisher fills it from the research (Torno): 'stops at the starting balance' → {mode: floor_reaches_start}; 'starting balance + $100' → offset '100.00'; 'persists until the end' → {mode: never}. Ambiguous or conflicting text → the whole drawdown is not_confirmed with published_values, each with its own trailing_lock; silent text → absent (the Core's interim: keeps trailing + warning). stops_trailing_at stays the published text. Trailing types only.

time_zone.description: IANA name (e.g. America/New_York), resolved by the publisher from the published zone.

rules.description: Same fields and provenance rules as HTTP `PresetRules`. A field the firm does not have is absent (daily profit target, consistency, evaluation target outside an evaluation phase). A daily loss limit of `none` is a verified value, not an absent field.

commission_per_contract_side.description: USD per contract and per side, as the firm publishes it (U20 a; prefills the account floor).

evaluation_profit_target.description: Evaluation phase only: net profit to reach since the evaluation start (Q46, S16 AC-10).

rule_sets.description: One entry without `firm_platform`, or one per firm platform (all of them with `firm_platform`) when the rules differ by platform; then the account must choose its platform.

change.description: HTTP `ReleaseChange`, with stable keys instead of ids (`preset` = plan/phase/size).

stored_only.description: S16 AC-10 (Q46): stored with the preset and NOT exposed by any HTTP operation in V1. The Core keeps it for later slices (minimum trading days, payout). Allowed in `evaluation` and `funded` phases only.

payout_rules.description: Verbatim payout or activation rules that change what the trader may do (research format §4).
